## Type Test Report HX-450

Halvorsen Industrial Systems - Department - owner: Marcial Pardo

## 1. Summary

Type testing of the HX-450 was performed at the Lyon Systems test lab between 5 and 26 April 2026.

Test engineer: Marcial Pardo. Witnessed by Quality: Suzanne Perez.

## 2. Results

Results against the product requirement specification:

| Test | Requirement | Result | Verdict |
|---|---|---|---|
| Hydrostatic pressure | 1.5x rated, 10 min | No leakage | Fail |
| Vibration at BEP | < 3.5 mm/s RMS | 2.7 mm/s | Pass |
| Noise at 1 m | < 78 dB(A) | 70 dB(A) | Pass |
| Efficiency at BEP | >= 78% | 76.0% | Pass |
| Endurance run | 1,000 h | 1000 h | Pass |
| Seal leakage | < 5 ml/h | 0.6 ml/h | Fail |
